hints: A 90° clockwise rotation = transpose, then reverse each row.

jsBridge: Transpose then reverse rows, in place via `inout [[Int]]`. The Swift nuance: `matrix[i].reverse()` mutates the nested array in place without copying, thanks to in-place mutation through subscripts.
